a.lede: A leader of the Scattered Spider cybercrime collective has been sentenced to six years in prison in the United States for stealing millions in cryptocurrency and conspiring to hack a dozen companies. [...]
a.title: British Scattered Spider hacker sentenced to 6 years in prison

b.lede: Tyler Buchanan, from Dundee, was a member of the notorious Scattered Spider group and began hacking when he was a teenager.
b.title: British hacker who stole $11m through text message scheme jailed for six years in US
